title: Episode About the Battle at Anandpur Sahib

blocks.text: When the Guru seeks the written declaration again, the Khalsa would not abandon Sikhi, answering that heads may be lost but not faith or the Guru’s command. (35–38)
The Guru praises the Khalsa for preserving the seed of Sikhi, and the exchange becomes one of mutual love, resolve, and shared burden in the face of collapse. (38–40)
By evening preparations are made to leave Anandpur, with the Sahibzadas and scattered Singhs moving out in broken groups as confusion and pursuit begin immediately. (41–43)
